mobbin:f8f82b62-60bc-404c-a1c1-af41afce5.summary: From Spend reimbursements the user opens Upload receipts, watches upload then AI matching, reviews extracted vendor/amount, and chooses Card expense or Reimbursement (or Delete/Skip).
steps: Receipts ready to review — extracted card
Match this receipt — Card expense / Reimbursement
steal: Non-blocking copy “upload more while they match” during Uploading and Matching (steps 2–3) — batch intake without waiting on each file.
Matching… with sparkle on the file row (step 3) — explicit AI-in-progress state before results.
Ready-to-review card with vendor, date, amount, thumbnail (step 4) — glance-check OCR before deep edit.
Match sheet with primary/secondary destinations plus Delete and Skip (step 5) — human route for unmatched or wrong extracts.
avoid: Card expense vs Reimbursement fork (step 5) is spend-ledger routing; inventory needs match-to-shelf / create-item / flag-shortage, not payment buckets.
mobbin:f8f82b62-60bc-404c-a1c1-af41afce5.fit: Extends Baseline for ai-equipment: scenario/equipment list upload → AI extract → review → match-or-route unmatched; maps receipt→expense match onto list→shelf match and shortages.

mobbin:30099a43-f093-441a-b868-b6a69e2da.summary: From empty Bills the user opens Add new bill, drops an invoice, waits through Extracting bill details, edits OCR-filled fields and line items with Match with PO, comments, submits, and lands on a statused Bills table with success toast.
steps: Add new bill — dropzone + empty form
Line items — Match with PO + qty/price
Bills list — success toast + status badges
steal: Source PDF left / structured form right (steps 4–7) — verify extract against original while editing.
Extracting… modal with “up to a minute” (step 3) — honest AI wait without freezing the form chrome.
Match with PO line item on each extracted line (steps 5–6) — explicit link of parsed text to an existing catalog record.
Draft vs Pending approval vs Overdue on the post-submit table (step 8) — lifecycle after AI create.
avoid: Marketing Spend hub (step 0) and accounting-connect banners add noise before the actual extract/match work.
mobbin:30099a43-f093-441a-b868-b6a69e2da.fit: Best adjacent pattern for Baseline ai-equipment: paste/upload scenario equipment list → extract lines → match each to shelf/PO-like catalog → save draft or flag gaps; Overdue badge also models late returns.
